note: Per-transaction scheme limits of the Indian payment rails. Banks may set lower customer limits. Edit or replace this document in MongoDB (collection country_operating_limits); the application never overwrites it.

rails.label: UPI
rails.note: Per transaction; some categories (for example tax payments) allow more. Person-to-person UPI carries no fee.

rails.label: NEFT
rails.note: No scheme minimum or maximum; individual banks may set their own.

rails.label: RTGS
rails.note: Minimum per transaction; no scheme maximum.

rails.label: ATM cash withdrawal
rails.note: Typical per-transaction cap of an ATM; each bank and card sets its own. Dispensed in whole notes.

note: Scheme limits of the UK payment rails. Banks may set lower limits. Edit or replace this document in MongoDB (collection country_operating_limits); the application never overwrites it.

rails.label: Faster Payments
rails.note: Scheme maximum per payment; banks set their own, often lower, limits.
